coach_says: TSB is -55.5 and Garmin reports UNPRODUCTIVE with rising resting HR, so this is a mandated recovery week with only one quality session — your non-negotiable Tuesday MTB group ride. All other sessions are easy Zone 1-2 or active recovery to restore freshness and address the deep fatigue hole. The aerobic-high shortage will be targeted once TSB recovers above -30; adding intensity now would compromise safety and adaptation.

days.details:
40 min | Objective: Active recovery
Gentle flow focusing on hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and breathing.
Keep heart rate low — this is preparation for Tuesday, not training.

90 min | Objective: Sole quality session of the week
Ride the group ride as it comes — this is your one hard session.
Skip any optional morning ride this week given TSB -55.5.
Fuel well before and during, prioritise post-ride recovery meal and early sleep.
If weather is wet, substitute a 45 min easy Zone 1-2 indoor spin.

Complete rest day.
Optional 10-15 min gentle stretching or short walk only.
Focus on sleep, hydration and nutrition.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x100m easy freestyle, 20 sec rest — smooth technique focus
Cooldown: 100m easy backstroke/choice
Total: ~700m
Objective: Low-impact circulation and recovery, RPE 2-3.

90 min | Objective: Easy aerobic maintenance
90 min steady Zone 1-2, RPE 3-4, flat or gently rolling terrain
High cadence 90+ rpm, no surges, no hills pushed hard
Cap the ride here — no extended long ride this week due to recovery status.

60 min | Objective: Active recovery
Relaxed walk at conversational pace, ideally in nature.
No pack weight, no pace targets.

60 min | Objective: Gentle aerobic flush
60 min Zone 1-2, RPE 3, easy gearing and high cadence
If HRV or resting HR has not improved by Sunday, replace with full rest or 30 min yoga.
